regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, one-narrative regime: Banks (H + HK) is the only durable leader (durability_bar 0.54, eligible, score 1.183), everything else is ranked lower and ineligible, and only 2 of 17 themes pass the absolute-trend gate (frac 0.12). Rotation is not directional (one_narrative true, absorption 0.48), and backtest verdict says the rank is an attention lens, not alpha, while the absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg. No scorable ETF proxy exists for any of the top 5 themes, so gradable subjects are limited to the two scorable China tech ETFs — both of which sit near the bottom, ineligible, and negative-score. Given the near-total lack of scorable, eligible themes, most of this note is a no-lean on leader continuation rather than a call.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (H-shares) — the current challenger at score 0.98 but ineligible (durability_bar 0.36, trend tag, breadth 0.3) — crosses into eligible status via the absolute-trend gate and closes the score margin against Banks below 0.10. That would be the first observable sign of a confirmed handoff in this one-narrative regime.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the only eligible, durable leader in a one-narrative regime. The absolute-trend gate (validated for drawdown control here, gate_helps true) is the one leg with edge, and it currently admits Banks while excluding the rest — so the disciplined lean is to keep exposure to the only theme still inside the gate, not to chase anything below it. Rank, durability_bar 0.54, and breadth 0.385 describe leadership concentration but do not forecast returns, so this is a stay-in-leader rather than a fresh-buy call.
evidence: rank 1, score 1.183, eligible true (only top theme eligible alongside Conglomerates)
hurst_tag mean-revert, crowded false, one_narrative true
theses.dissent: Mean-revert Hurst tag and a negative r10 of -0.0126 suggest internal momentum is already fading; a single-theme regime is fragile precisely because no breadth (0.385) or rotation confirms it, and leadership without followers can compress hard once the gate flips.

theses.subject: Conglomerates & Exchange
theses.thesis: Conglomerates is the only other eligible theme (passing the absolute-trend gate), which is the one leg with a validated drawdown-control edge. In a one-narrative regime where Banks is the leader, Conglomerates is the nearest eligible challenger. A low-conviction lean to the second eligible name is consistent with staying inside the gate while not fading the leader. However it is unscorable (no ETF proxy), so this is largely a descriptive lean.
theses.dissent: Score is well below Banks (0.738 vs 1.183) and momentum rank-IC is ~0 — being eligible does not mean it should be preferred over cash, and a mixed Hurst tag gives no trend-health confirmation.

falsifier.text: Conglomerates loses eligible status via the absolute-trend gate while Banks remains eligible

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: This is one of only two scorable themes (ETF proxy 3033.HK), but it sits near the bottom (rank 13, score -0.797), is ineligible through the absolute-trend gate, and carries a mean-revert tag with negative breadth. The discipline says the gate is the validated leg, and this theme is outside it. Avoid expresses the allocation stance from the gate, not a short or fade call.
theses.dissent: Negative score and mean-revert tag could mean it is near a counter-trend bounce, but there is no edge to trade that from this detector, and the gate pointing away is the only disciplined signal.
